note: Detection thresholds for the AI content detector. Two-FPR zone model: scores at or above tauFpr1 map to the confident zone, tauFpr5 to the likely zone (and symmetrically on the human side); the band between the zones is an abstention area. scoreMidpoint/scoreScale were fit on a quick 8-sample probe (4 AI / 4 human, 2026-08-21) after the model-pair fix: ratios were ~1.42-1.51 (AI) vs ~0.99-1.04 (human), so midpoint sits midway at 1.23 with the sigmoid increasing in score. MUST be re-fit on a larger domain calibration corpus before trusting the numbers (v1.5 backlog). Code zone reuses the text calibration as an interim — code-specific corpus pending.
